HousekeepingOps-3D Benchmark
	

Hierarchical Multi-Agent Hotel Housekeeping Benchmark in AI2-THOR 3D

	
		
		Overview
	

HousekeepingOps-3D is a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical multi-agent coordination in realistic hotel housekeeping scenarios. It uses AI2-THOR 3D environments with a 3-tier agent hierarchy (Orchestrator → Sector VLM → Execution Robots) and a 4×4 cross-evaluation grid to systematically diagnose where coordination fails.
